authority: Owner requested improvement of the thread-created skill and copies in both repositories; owner selected a substantial v1.2 increment.
hash_scope: All package files except benchmarks/**; UTF-8 file bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; case-sensitive Unicode code-point ordering of slash-separated relative paths; path + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + LF
recovery: Original committed versions and feature branches retained; no unrelated worktree or stash modified.
verification_contract: Verify destination still matches the inspected five-file baseline before copying. Verify identical full relative-path inventories and raw bytes afterward, including all review records. Store the full computed inventory outside the package to avoid self-reference.
excluded: Private review workspace, task-board bodies, transcripts, UI captures and machine-specific paths
publication_scope: Reviewed draftable contract and catalogs; no Replit task or global host configuration changes.
